title: Replay meal-description against a real model
objective: Measure the prompt that writes the one sentence a Customer reads, rather than the parser around it. It is the only prompt whose output reaches a Customer verbatim and it has never been scored.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/replay-goldens.ts is generalised beyond the single prompt it is hardcoded to, without changing what it measures for meal-analysis
the eight meal_description fixtures replay against the live fast-tier model
a report lands in docs/ops/ and last_evaluated on prompts/meal-description.md becomes a date
the shared register markers are reused, not re-implemented
notes: Gemini free tier is 15 requests per minute and the script refuses to run below 4000ms spacing. Do not fire it repeatedly. Nothing in the app calls meal-description yet, so this measures a component that is not installed — the coordinator may reasonably hold it until something does.
